<b>Freshflies</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the freshly-hatched young of the [[Broodmother]], who are still soft and blind but will grow up to be the [[Slab_Penitents#The_Jailers|jailers]] in [[the Slab]].<ref>Freshfly Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Infant fly, freshly hatched. At this age the soft, blind fly is little more than a bother."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Freshflies fly around the room in straight lines until they hit a wall, at which point they change direction. They deal damage on contact and explode after roughly 0.6 seconds when defeated, dealing additional damage in a radius to both Hornet and other enemies except Broodmother. The explosions deal {{Damage|2}}, and can kill other freshflies, resulting in them exploding as well. Their explosions deal 5 damage to other enemies.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Light! Light!
* Mother...
* Eat! Eat!
* Warm air...
}}

== Location ==
Freshflies can be found in the Slab during the Broodmother fight, which requires accepting [[The Wailing Mother]] [[Wish]].
